# Trupal Patel

> Software engineer at Aetna, a CVS Health company, and a member of trueorfalse.dev, True or False (https://trueorfalse.dev), a small software studio that builds mobile apps, web products and websites, ships them, and keeps them running.

## Overview
**Trupal Patel** (**TrupalIX9** on GitHub) is a full-stack software engineer. His day job is at Aetna (CVS Health), working on utilization management and care management with BigQuery and AI. He is also a member of **trueorfalse.dev** (True or False), whose motto is "Every idea starts false. We ship it true." He works across the whole stack: Flutter and React front ends, Node.js, Django and FastAPI back ends, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and BigQuery, and Google Cloud, AWS and Cloudflare.

## Career History

### Software Development Engineer @ Aetna, a CVS Health company (Oct 2026 – present)
Cloud-native applications on Google Cloud for utilization management and care management: BigQuery analytics and data pipelines, GenAI prototypes, and APIs for AI-enabled applications. Python, SQL, GCP (Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI).

### Founding Software Engineer @ Allyvia (Jul 2025 – Apr 2026)
Allyvia is a cloud-native SaaS platform built to streamline B2B operations. Trupal engineered the platform from the ground up on Google Cloud:
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage).
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Architected a cloud-native, full-stack SaaS platform on GCP using Python, React 19, TypeScript and Django REST Framework.
  - Engineered BigQuery-based analytics and data processing pipelines syncing QuickBooks accounting data, with incremental loads and Python transformations keeping API latency under 200ms.
  - Built secure multi-tenant workflows: PIN-authorized kiosk clock-in/out consoles, RBAC route guarding and OAuth token refresh cycles.
  - Developed AI-enabled REST APIs using GCP Cloud Storage and Pub/Sub for event-driven ingestion in a GenAI prototype assistant.
  - Delivered CRM, inventory, employee and finance modules with multi-module reporting and analytics.

### Software Engineer @ AIVID.AI (Jan 2023 – Jun 2025)
AIVID.AI provides enterprise-scale edge computer vision and analytics across 200+ deployment sites.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C# (WinForms/NSSM), Elasticsearch, Docker.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Built analytics pipelines and operations portals deployed across 200+ enterprise sites.
  - Reduced fraudulent customer return claims by 90% by engineering a C# / EmguCV barcode-triggered video capture bot.
  - Improved massive-scale Elasticsearch query retrieval speeds by ~25% using optimized DSL aggregations.
  - Developed multi-ISP dynamic failover systems for uninterrupted edge RTSP camera stream capturing.
  - Integrated serial Arduino microcontrollers with containerized Python edge daemons for local gate access control.

### Frontend Software Engineer @ InfoLabz (Jan 2022 – Dec 2022)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Redux, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Developed scalable, highly responsive user interfaces and robust state management utilizing Redux.
  - Collaborated across teams to seamlessly integrate RESTful APIs and eliminate UI defects.

## Professional Philosophy
"For me, it is all about deeply understanding a problem, designing a scalable architecture, and writing clean code that makes a real impact. I would love to bring this exact same drive and architectural vision to your team."

## Project Case Studies
- [RetailSync](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/retailsync): full-stack multi-tenant SaaS with POS ingestion, bank statement OCR and QuickBooks sync.
- [Web Warehouse](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/web-warehouse): inventory and purchase-order management with a 3D warehouse model in Three.js.
- [Shipping Agent](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/shipping-agent): an AI shipping desk that quotes every carrier through ShipStation and checks out to a printable label.
- [Fire Forecasting](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/fire-forecasting): a wildfire risk dashboard prototype for the Tri-County area.
- [ZoneWatch](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/motion-detection): a C# Windows app for ONVIF IP cameras with EmguCV motion detection and PTZ control.
- [Gatelog](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/vehicle-log): a Windows installer and updater for a vehicle-log server stack.
- [WebGL Academic Presentation](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/comp-599-webgl): a seminar slide deck where every slide runs a live Three.js scene.
- [File System Engine](https://www.trupalpatel.com/projects/file-system-engine): an Electron file manager with a dual-pane Transfer Hub and a treemap disk analyzer.
